label: outputLevelsRoundTrip: a save drops output white, so a file's output levels come back as 1
hueSatFields: an opened file's hue and saturation land in each other's fields
find:
hue: try c.decode(Double.self, forKey: .hue),
            saturation: try c.decode(Double.self, forKey: .saturation),
replace:
hue: try c.decode(Double.self, forKey: .saturation),
            saturation: try c.decode(Double.self, forKey: .hue),
